description: Costs 2¢ per call. Reads a part's datasheet. Section mode (default): start with section='summary' for an overview and available_sections, then ask for any section by name; names come from the datasheet's own headings (e.g. 'register_map', 'i2c_interface'); an unknown name returns the nearest section names and pages. Use max_chars and the returned next_offset to continue a long read. Search mode (mode='search' with a query): semantic search within this datasheet, for targeted questions such as a register bit field or an I2C address. Prefer specific sections to section='all', which can fill your context. The first read of a new part starts extraction and returns status='extracting' (not charged). A datasheet nobody has read before usually takes 1-3 minutes, 5 or more for a large one or a busy queue. These are estimates, not deadlines. For microcontrollers, register-level programming detail usually lives in a separate reference manual, not the datasheet; available_sections shows what is present. datasheet_status: 'ready' → read it; 'extracting' / 'queued' / 'pending' / 'resolving' → poll check_extraction_status; 'not_extracted' → prefetch_datasheets; 'no_source' / 'unsupported' → request_datasheet_upload. Full list in the server instructions.

limit.description: Max search results in search mode (default 3). Each result includes adjacent context chunks.

max_chars.description: Text budget; a whole sentence or table row may exceed it.

mode.description: 'section' (default) returns a named section, 'search' does semantic search

offset.description: Continue a section using next_offset from the previous read.

part_number.description: Specific manufacturer part number (MPN) or LCSC number (e.g. 'TPS54302DDCR', 'C2837938'). Not a value ('100nF'), description or reference designator ('R1').

query.description: Search query; required when mode='search', ignored otherwise. Example: 'charge voltage register', 'I2C address'.

section.description: Section name for section mode. Start with 'summary' to discover available sections. Common: summary, pinout, electrical, abs_max, register_map, timing, package. Any heading in the datasheet works (slugified).
